scripts.upload: rclone --config rclone.conf copy disthash: s3:jbrowse.org/plugins --checksum --fast-list --exclude '**/latest/**' --header-upload 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=31536000, immutable' && rclone --config rclone.conf copy disthash: s3:jbrowse.org/plugins --checksum --fast-list --include '**/latest/**' --header-upload 'Cache-Control: no-cache, must-revalidate' && rclone --config rclone.conf copyto v2_plugins.json s3:jbrowse.org/plugin-store/v2/plugins.json --checksum --header-upload 'Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, must-revalidate, s-maxage=86400'
scripts.dep: pnpm update-plugins && pnpm verify && git add dist v2_plugins.json && if git diff --cached --quiet; then pnpm upload; else git commit -m 'Updates' && git push && pnpm upload && pnpm invalidate; fi
